RESOLUTION #6
(Series of 2026)
A RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF SELECTMEN FOR THE TOWN OF
GEORGETOWN, COLORADO AMENDING THE TOWN FEE SCHEDULE
WHEREAS, the Town of Georgetown is a Colorado municipal corporation operating under
a Territorial Charter and governed by its Board of Selectmen; and
WHEREAS, the Board is authorized to adopt rules, regulations and restrictions for the
protection of the public health, safety and welfare; and
WHEREAS, in the exercise of this authority, the Board of Selectmen has previously
adopted the Town Fee Schedule via resolution, pursuant to Code Section 3.16.010; and
WHEREAS, the Board of Selectmen is also authorized to adopt water system development
fees by resolution pursuant to Code Section 13.18.030; and
WHEREAS, the current Fee Schedule provides for water system development fees at two
levels: "Development" and "Large Development" projects, respectively; and
WHEREAS, the Board finds that, upon the advice of the Town's consulting engineer,
development fees for the water system should be based on a single metric - the number of
Equivalent Residential Units (EQR's) proposed to be added to the system by the development
involved, and the Board wishes to amend the Fee Schedule accordingly.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE BOARD OF SELECTMAN FOR
GEORGETOWN, COLORADO:
Section 1.
The water system development Fee Schedule previously approved by
Resolution WWE-2 on June 28, 2022, is amended by combining the existing schedule lines for
"Development" and for "Large Development," into a single schedule line entitled simply
"Development," and establishing the development fee for that single category as $11,475 per
EQR.
Section 2.
This Resolution shall be effective immediately upon adoption.
RESOLVED, APPROVED and ADOPTED this _jO_ day of March 2026.
TOWN OF GEORGETOWN
By:
Dergin Kotver
Georgia Kofoed, Police Judge
ATTEST:
Brigitte Korte, Town Clerk
